result.question: When did Jotham address Shechem's leaders?

readings.answer: On the day they rose up against his father’s house and killed his seventy sons
readings.support: you have risen up against my father’s house this day and killed his seventy sons on a single stone

readings.answer: After they had made Abimelech king over the leaders of Shechem
readings.support: you have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the leaders of Shechem

assessments.reason: The phrase “you have risen up against my father’s house this day and killed his seventy sons” anchors Jotham’s address to the same day as the killings.

Jotham says, “you have made Abimelech … king over the leaders of Shechem,” indicating he spoke after they had made Abimelech king, which is a valid temporal description though not the same phrasing as the key.

result.reason: The text supports both that he spoke on the day of the killings and that he spoke after they had made Abimelech king, yielding two distinct acceptable timings.
